skins.name: Traceless Walker
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Traceless Walker. Custom-made by the Lateran Curia for certain Legati. Sankta who get custom outfits all share a common feature: there is something unusual about their halos.
skins.quote: Before reuniting with his teammates, he took up the duties of a Legatus, traveling among the nations of Terra.
